description: Code-behind file for the 'EditExam' page in an online examination system, handling server-side events triggered by user interactions such as button clicks, which navigate to various other pages.

classes.name: EditExam
classes.description: Partial class representing the code-behind for the EditExam ASP.NET web form, containing event handlers for button clicks that navigate to different pages.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Event handler for the page load event, currently does not perform any actions.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for the 'home' button click; transfers user to the AdminPanel page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for the 'profile' button click; transfers user to the AdminQueue page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for the 'leaderboard' button click; transfers user to the AdminLeaderboard page.

methods.name: eTheoryB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for the 'edit theory' button click; transfers user to the EditTheory page.

methods.name: eMcqB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for the 'edit MCQ' button click; transfers user to the EditMCQ page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for the 'logout' button click; transfers user to the LoginPage.
